svg.title: Food preoccupation and hunger 12 weeks after stopping semaglutide
svg.desc: University of Pennsylvania trial NCT05548647, results posted on ClinicalTrials.gov. Past-week food preoccupation on a 0 to 100 scale: 63.1 for everyone before the trial; at week 72, 26.4 in people still on semaglutide, 42.7 in people who had placebo with lifestyle counseling throughout, and 62.9 in people switched from semaglutide to placebo 12 weeks earlier. Past-week hunger: 63.8 before; 38.5, 48.5 and 63.6.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Thoughts about food came back within 12 weeks of stopping
